them.en: The guidelines make the agent do
them.zh: 这份准则让 agent 做的

steps.en: Add its marketplace and install the Claude Code plugin (or curl CLAUDE.md into a project)
steps.zh: 加上它的 marketplace，装 Claude Code 插件

steps.en: Four principles join the agent's standing instructions in every project
steps.zh: 四条原则进入 agent 在每个项目里的常驻指令

steps.en: Give a task, ideally with a checkable goal like a failing test
steps.zh: 布置任务，最好带一个可检验的目标，比如一个会失败的测试

steps.en: States its assumptions and asks when the request is ambiguous, before writing code
steps.zh: 动手前先摆出假设，需求有歧义就先问

steps.en: Writes the minimum change, touches only lines your request needs, loops until the check passes
steps.zh: 只写最少的改动、只碰需求涉及的行，循环到检查通过

value.en: Smaller diffs, questions before mistakes instead of after, and no drive-by refactoring
value.zh: diff 更小，问题在犯错前问而不是犯错后，也没有顺手的重构
